newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Giribaldi ups CIR stake to 15.2pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Giribaldi ups CIR stake to 15.2pct.

text.p: Italian financier Luigi Giribaldi has raised his stake in industrial holding company CIR to 15.19 percent from 13.2 percent previously, a communication from the Milan bourse said on Monday.
The financier has entrusted his stake to Banque du Gothard, and the bank now has a total stake of 15.26 percent in CIR, as it also holds other stakes for other unidentified persons.

The latest figures show that Giribaldi also has a stake of 20.3 percent in Cofide, the holding company of Carlo De Benedetti. Cofide holds just over 50 percent of CIR which in turn is still the signal largest shareholder in information and technology group Olivetti with a stake of 9.3 percent.
According to Italian newspaper reports, Giribaldi has a one percent stake in Olivetti.
